$comment: Classroom access switches. These are navigation deterrents, NOT security: this file and the page are public and anyone can read or change what their own browser does. Never put real passwords, student data or restricted content here; use Canvas or district-approved authenticated hosting for anything that must be private. college.enabled must stay false unless college-level instruction is authorized. To change a code, open the site, run SLAccess.hash("college", "new-code") or SLAccess.hash("teacher", "new-code") in the browser console, and paste the result here.
